explanation: Complete proof. (1) An abstract three-level streaming automaton (step1/step2/step3) folded over encodeTuple [pw, encGates gs, [beta]] computes evalGates and reads beta (foldl_step1_input). (2) Each automaton step is realised by the stream-loop body on a 40-tape store (run_pStep1), using single carry primitives for wire lookup, gate write and one-hot marker shift (hd_lookup, write_encW, shift_hot). (3) One evaluation (run_evalOne), the 8 nested enumeration loops via a tape-avoidance commutation lemma (run_nest), and counting through all 128-bit words with carry addBit (orIter_all) give the output [true, beta && sat, false] (run_encProg); Dec outputs the last 3 bits (run_decProg). (4) Correctness and false-statement security follow as for the existence-level baseline; the cost is bounded by the NB.check certificates (decide +kernel) for timeBoundT plus the description lengths.
